verdict.rationale: The only delegated-access evidence is that a Premier Business Services account can give staff access to a shared payment account for submitting filings, and that the division publishes step-by-step videos for setting one up. Nothing in the pack spells out what a third party may or may not do on a business's behalf. Missing for 10: published third-party authorization or power-of-attorney forms, defined delegate roles and their permitted actions, rules on which signatures or attestations must stay personal to officers/members, and any independent corroboration.
